title: Make coverage result pass state honor non-blocking modes
goal: Make coverage JSON carry the same non-blocking off and warn semantics already promised by the schema and CLI exit contract.
in_scope: Compute passed as true in off and warn modes for successful below-threshold stack results
Compute passed as true in off and warn modes for errored stack results while preserving status and diagnostics
Apply the mode rule to fresh results, --reuse per-stack reevaluation, and aggregate summary.passed
Preserve threshold and error blocking in enforce mode
Regression-test that rendered CI can continue trusting summary.passed as the single source of truth
out_of_scope: Suppressing coverage error or below-threshold reporting in off or warn mode
Automatically overwriting seed-only workflows in already-adopted projects
Changing the render-workflow TAIL unless tests prove a defensive mode guard is still required
Backporting the fix into downstream repositories during this story
acceptance: coverage.mjs --json reports passed: true for off and warn modes even when an ok stack is below threshold or a stack errors, while enforce mode preserves the real threshold and error outcome; the same rule governs fresh per-stack results, --reuse reevaluation, and the aggregate summary in both the self-hosted and shipped scaffold copies, so rendered CI may trust summary.passed without turning a reporting mode into a blocking gate.
invariants: status and diagnostic details remain truthful even when passed is non-blocking
Enforce mode remains fail-closed for errors and below-threshold coverage
The CLI exit code and serialized passed field express the same mode contract
Existing downstream workflows remain project-owned and require explicit manual rerender or targeted force after upgrade
